technical_summary: Needs a two-tier solution: low-latency streaming endpoint for IDE copilot (target token latency <50ms 95th), model/version pinning for deterministic completions, and a separate high-throughput batch pipeline for nightly embedding refresh and incremental indexing (target 60k embeddings/hour sustained, 500k total nightly). Wants automatic routing/fallback to small cached model for offline dev mode + deterministic rollouts for releases.
integration_notes: Will integrate with internal repo store (git enterprise), internal SSO (SAML), and their vector DB (self-hosted). Expect frequent small commits; embedding pipeline must support incremental diffs rather than full re-embeds each time. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/quantization to reduce cost.
proof_points_from_poc: Day 3 smoke: streaming pipeline stable at 40-55ms median token latency on dedicated n1-small-like instances; nightly embed worker processed 120k files in 3 hours with batching changes. SE recommends cache TTLs and prefix caching to avoid re-tokenizing large files repeatedly.
pricing_objections: Worries about ARR variance as dev seats scale. Wants a committed reserved capacity option for embedding throughput and burst buffers for IDE traffic.
